title: Kind schema
description: The configuration a resource of this kind accepts, as JSON Schema plus the `x-telo-*` annotations that say how each field behaves.

type.title: Type
type.description: The JSON type this value must have, or a list of accepted types.

properties.title: Properties
properties.description: Schema per named property of an object.

required.title: Required
required.description: Property names that must be present.

additionalProperties.title: Additional properties
additionalProperties.description: `false` rejects any property not named above — which is what makes a typo an error rather than an ignored field.

patternProperties.title: Pattern properties
patternProperties.description: Schema per regular expression matching a property name.

propertyNames.title: Property names
propertyNames.description: Schema every property NAME must satisfy.

items.title: Items
items.description: Schema for each element of an array.

additionalItems.title: Additional items
additionalItems.description: Schema for elements past a positional `items` list.

contains.title: Contains
contains.description: At least one element must satisfy this schema.

anyOf.title: Any of
anyOf.description: At least one branch must match.

oneOf.title: One of
oneOf.description: Exactly one branch must match. Prefer `anyOf` when a branch declares a value type — a consumer that does not know the keyword reads the branch as matching everything, and only `anyOf` degrades gracefully.

not.title: Not
not.description: The value must NOT match this schema.

enum.title: Enum
enum.description: The complete set of accepted values.

default.title: Default
default.description: Filled in when the value is absent. On an invocation contract this is applied at dispatch, so a caller may omit the field.

pattern.title: Pattern
pattern.description: Regular expression the string must match.

contentMediaType.title: Content media type
contentMediaType.description: Media type of the string's content (`application/javascript`). Drives the editor's code-widget language.

dependencies.title: Dependencies
dependencies.description: Per property, the other properties it requires — or a schema to apply.

description.title: Description
description.description: What this value is, for the author reading the manifest.

$ref.title: Reference
$ref.description: Pointer to another schema: `#/$defs/<Name>` for one declared below, `telo:<module>/<Type>` for a named type a module declared.

$defs.title: Definitions
$defs.description: Named sub-schemas, private to this schema, referenced with `#/$defs/<Name>`.
